description: Indulge in the rich and creamy flavors of Butter Chicken, a beloved Indian classic known for its tender chicken pieces simmered in a luscious tomato-based gravy. This Murgh Makhani recipe offers a perfect balance of sweet, tangy, and mildly spicy notes, making it a comforting and satisfying meal. Prepare to savor every spoonful of this iconic dish, a true testament to Indian culinary artistry.

ingredients.notes: soaked in warm water for 15 min

instructions.title: Marinate the Chicken
instructions.text: In a large bowl, combine chicken pieces with yogurt, ginger-garlic paste, red chili powder, turmeric powder, garam masala, and salt. Mix well to coat all chicken pieces. Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes, or preferably 2-4 hours for best flavor.

instructions.title: Cook the Chicken
instructions.text: Heat 2 tablespoons of butter in a large pan or skillet over medium-high heat. Add the marinated chicken pieces and cook in batches if necessary, until they are browned on all sides and cooked through. This usually takes about 5-7 minutes per batch. Remove chicken and set aside.

instructions.title: Prepare the Sauce Base
instructions.text: In the same pan, add 1 tablespoon of oil and 2 tablespoons of butter. Once melted, add the finely chopped onion and cook until softened and translucent, about 5-7 minutes. Add ginger-garlic paste and green chilies (if using), and saute for another 2 minutes until fragrant.

instructions.title: Simmer the Tomato Gravy
instructions.text: Stir in the tomato puree, soaked cashews, sugar, Kashmiri red chili powder, coriander powder, and cumin powder. Mix well and bring to a simmer. Cover and cook for 10-15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the sauce thickens and the oil separates from the edges. This allows the flavors to meld.

instructions.title: Blend and Finish the Sauce
instructions.text: Remove the pan from heat and let it cool slightly. Transfer the sauce mixture to a blender and blend until completely smooth. Pass the blended sauce through a fine-mesh sieve back into the pan for an extra silky texture. Add the remaining 2 tablespoons of butter and garam masala to the sieved sauce.

instructions.title: Combine Chicken and Sauce
instructions.text: Return the pan to medium heat. Add the cooked chicken pieces to the smooth butter chicken sauce. Stir in the crushed kasoori methi and simmer for another 5-7 minutes, allowing the chicken to absorb the flavors of the sauce. Stir in the heavy cream just before serving, heating through gently without boiling.

instructions.title: Serve Hot
instructions.text: Garnish with fresh chopped coriander leaves. Serve hot with naan bread, roti, or basmati rice. Enjoy your homemade classic Butter Chicken!

tips: For an extra tender chicken, marinate the chicken overnight in the refrigerator. The longer marination time allows the yogurt to tenderize the meat beautifully.

Achieve a super silky sauce by thoroughly blending the gravy base and then straining it through a fine-mesh sieve. This step removes any small bits of onion or cashews, giving it a restaurant-quality texture.
Always add the heavy cream at the very end of cooking and avoid boiling the sauce once the cream is added. This prevents the cream from curdling and keeps the sauce smooth and luscious.
